messages:
marta (PM): Quick sync 1 ACME pilot timeline 2026-04-01. Need minimal launch scope + owners for three gates: runtime KV change, CMK onboarding, staging prewarm. Who owns what?

alex (Eng): I can own the runtime changes. Need a short acceptance checklist. Is canary without CMK acceptable?

sam (Runtime): Canary sans-CMK ok if fallback isolates tenant data and we emit audit events. Note: KV tweak may add ~8ms p95; will bench.

jess (Infra): Prewarm choices: burstable hosted (fast, quota req ~3d) or Dedicated pool (provision ~1wk). Recommend burstable to meet date.

casey (SRE): If burstable, set alert: sustained_utilization >70% for 2h -> conversion runbook. Ill own runbook.

li (Security): CMK onboarding needs HSM + rotation policy review; earliest review slot 2026-03-18. If canary runs without CMK, provide data-separation doc and TRANSPORT encryption proof.

alex (Eng): Draft checklist: 1) E2E on ACME test tenant with prefix cache; 2) simulated KMS failure fallback validated; 3) staging p95 <120ms; 4) canary flag + rollback path.

marta (PM): Add security sign-off (li) and infra prewarm applied (jess). Action owners: alex (delivery plan + rollback, Thu COB), sam (perf matrix, Fri EOD), jess (open quota ticket), li (security review), casey (alert/runbook). Reply with "ack" to accept.

alex (Eng): ack

sam (Runtime): ack  will post perf results to /perf/results

jess (Infra): ack  opening INFRA ticket today

casey (SRE): ack  will include maintenance window block in runbook

li (Security): ack  will slot review after design doc

marta (PM): Thanks  I'll compile a one-page launch checklist after Thu updates.
